mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -17.4% to -8.9% over four weeks, indicating a consistent recovery trend. This momentum will persist over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC further above the recent mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 8.5 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the mean of the last 28 days, or decelerates to a rate of improvement less than 2 percentage points per week.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has recovered from -22.7% to -6.6% over four weeks. When workplace attendance crosses above -10%, commuter-adjacent retail spending accelerates. This threshold crossing will trigger sustained retail recovery over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES at t-0w is -6.6%, above -10% threshold
failure_condition: WORKPLACES falls back below -10% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to improve by at least 3 percentage points over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility spiked to 50.3% at t-0w after declining to 12.7% at t-1w. High outdoor recreation crowds signal consumer confidence and foot traffic that spills into adjacent retail venues. This outdoor-to-retail spillover will elevate RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility falls below 30% in the next week, or RETAIL_REC fails to improve week-on-week in at least 3 of the next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT stations remain depressed at -13.4%, indicating ongoing restrictions or low commuter confidence. Persistent transit suppression constrains retail foot traffic, as transit-dependent shoppers cannot access retail venues. RETAIL_REC will remain below baseline over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -12% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has not exceeded -13.4% in the last four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -10% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC improves by more than 5 percentage points over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has risen from 5.6% to 9.9% over four weeks, signaling increased essential-goods shopping. When essential shopping rises, consumers make co-located retail purchases. The interaction of rising GROCERY_PHARM and recovering WORKPLACES will amplify RETAIL_REC gains over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Either GROCERY_PHARM falls below 5% or WORKPLACES falls below -15% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to exceed -5% by week 2.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 4.4% to 0.7% over four weeks, indicating residents are spending more time outside the home. This shift in time allocation away from residential spaces will drive retail and recreation visits higher over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 2% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 3.7 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rises above 3% in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS and RETAIL_REC are both recovering from suppressed baselines. The joint recovery signal indicates a broad reopening of consumer mobility. When both series show positive momentum simultaneously, retail recovery accelerates. Over the next four weeks, this co-movement will sustain RETAIL_REC gains.
candidate_trigger: PARKS exceeds 40% AND RETAIL_REC improves week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:both improved from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS falls below 30% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines week-on-week in 2 or more of the next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT suppression at -13.4% constrains commuter-based retail access, while WORKPLACES recovery at -6.6% indicates some workers are returning via non-transit modes. This mismatch between workplace return and transit availability will limit RETAIL_REC growth to below 0% over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES exceeds -10% while TRANSIT remains below -12%
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -10% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC exceeds 0% by the end of week 2.
